name: CasePseudoDecorClipPath
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "pseudo-decor-clip-path" (pseudo-elements). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a DRAWN ::after decor box whose entire SHAPE is a clip-path (the antd tooltip arrow: a 16x8 solid box cut to a triangle) COMPUTED-ENRICHED (extract/computed): unlabeled styled channels minted from computed-style capture of @ds-contracts/conformance@0.1.0 in headless Chromium 151.0.7922.34; overflow channels in the sibling extension file.
